input: Table: Equipment plan. Headings: H1 = Plan, H2 = April, H3 = May. Row label R1L = Basic†. R1C1 = On. R1C2 = Off. Row label R2L = Premium. R2C1 = On. R2C2 = On. Legend: a marker in a row label applies to every data cell in that row; a marker in a data cell applies only to that cell. Definition † = seasonal only. No other markers, definitions, or scope rules are supplied.

scope_map.authorized_scope: All data cells in row R1
scope_map.rationale: The supplied legend expressly extends a marker in a row label to every data cell in that row.

explicitly_supplied_scopes: The † qualifier applies to R1C1 and R1C2 through the row-label rule.
outside_scope: The qualifier does not establish whether any equipment-plan value is accurate.
